Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about tracking day and night

How does the Day & Night Tracker work?

Our tracker uses seasonal sunrise/sunset data for each country combined with real-time local time calculations. It determines whether it's day or night, shows the current time, and calculates countdowns to the next sunrise or sunset.

How many countries can I track at once?

You can track up to 12 countries simultaneously. This limit ensures optimal performance and readability while giving you comprehensive day/night monitoring capabilities.

How accurate are the sunrise and sunset times?

The times are based on typical seasonal averages for each country's capital city. While actual times may vary slightly based on specific location within a country, they provide a reliable guide for day/night patterns.

Do you account for Daylight Saving Time (DST)?

Yes! All times automatically adjust for Daylight Saving Time where applicable. The timezone data includes DST rules for each region, ensuring you always see the correct local time.

What do the progress bars show?

The progress bars visually represent how much of the current day (if it's daytime) or night (if it's nighttime) has passed. A shimmering effect shows the current phase progressing toward the next transition.

How are seasons determined for each country?

Seasons are automatically determined based on the current month and each country's hemisphere. This ensures that sunrise/sunset times are appropriate for the actual season in that location.
